thread:
elaine: heads up — support ticket shows a customer hit org quota even though they used a service account we expected to map to a project. looks like fallback to org default. anyone tracked this? 
noah: saw similar alert yesterday. routing logs show claim.project missing, router picked org-owner as fallback. link to sample trace: trace-8ef3. 
elainE: (typo) elaine: repro steps: create SA without project, call /v1/embeddings with that key, response goes to org 0 and increments org quota. customer surprised. 
priya: console UX: we should show "Effective billing target" on key detail and add a one-click bind-to-project. that'll reduce surprise. 
noah: telemetry ask: emit tag routing.reason=[project,owner_org,default_org] and routing.assigned_id so we can aggregate. also add a small gauge for "unbound_sa_rate" per org. 
elainE: elaine: good. ops-bot: scheduled job auth-routing-sample (rate=0.005) 
ops-bot: created job auth-routing-sample id=ar-20260315-01 
priya: ops playbook needed: if we change router priority we must alert customers and have rollback. can we canary prefer X-Origin header when present? 
noah: simple canary plan: 5% of traffic prefers X-Origin header -> validate id and signature -> assign project. I'll open router patch and a canary flag. 
elainE: elaine: signature validation is necessary if we allow client-supplied origin. sketch: X-Origin: sa://<id>  X-Origin-Sig: base64(sig)  issuer pubkey lookup by iss claim. 
priya: agree. for UX also add banner where binding required: "This key currently maps to org X; bind to a project to avoid org quota usage" with link to docs. 
noah: I'll add metrics and a Grafana tile: "project-binding failures" + sample trace link. threshold alert if >0.2% changed assignments during canary. 
elainE: elaine: thanks. if canary shows >0.1% of requests mis-assigned or any customer escalation we cut the flag. otherwise roll out and ship console fix. 
priya: filing the short runbook now.
